fields.features_heading: What Every Job Application Form Needs
fields.features_subheading: A job application form collects one core record per candidate. Emergent adds role branching, uploads, PDFs, and an applicant table.
fields.feature_1:
Every section, field by field

Emergent drafts the six standard sections with the right input for each answer: a date picker for the start date, a phone field and a block that repeats for each past employer.
fields.feature_2:
One form for every open role

Applicants pick a position and see only the questions written for it. A forklift operator is asked for a certification date; a bookkeeper names the accounting software they use.
fields.feature_3:
Resume and certificate uploads

Applicants attach a resume and any license or certificate the role needs from a phone, without creating an account. Each file is stored with the application it arrived on.
fields.feature_4:
A filled PDF of every application

Each online application can be kept as a filled PDF in the same layout for the personnel file, typed signature included. Name each file by applicant and role, like Haddad_RN.pdf.
fields.feature_5:
An applicant table with hiring stages

Every application lands as a row with role, location, stage and owner, in a table that never caps applications. The app then alerts the hiring manager by Slack or email.
fields.feature_6:
Your careers page, your source code

Publish on a custom domain, included and paid in credits, or embed the form in the careers page you already run. The full source exports to your GitHub repository on paid plans.

fields.usecase_heading: Job Application Forms for Every Hire
fields.tab_content_1:
Know who can work weekends before you call

The first question is which store. Applicants then give a start date and tap the shifts they can work. That store's manager hears about it in Slack, and the applicant table filters by weekend availability.
fields.tab_content_2:
Catch any license due to lapse within 60 days

Each nurse gives a license number and the state that issued it, and medical assistants give their certification. Every expiry date has its own field, and the recruiter sees the flag before an interview is booked. BLS and ACLS cards upload on the same screen.
fields.tab_content_3:
Internal moves stay confidential until the final round

Employees apply with their employee ID and months in their current role. This posting asks for at least 12, and anyone short is told before they submit. Applications sit in a table kept apart from outside candidates. The current manager gets a Slack direct message only once a final interview is booked.
fields.tab_content_4:
The shortlist skips anyone who fails a must-have

Designers upload a resume and a portfolio, and answer two must-haves: expected salary and US work authorization. Anyone without work authorization, or asking above the posted band, goes to a hold list. The rest land in the design team's hiring channel in Slack as a shortlist.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Job Application Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to turn what a role requires into a job application form that fills your applicant table.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write down what the role requires
fields.howto_step_1_des: List what you need to know before a first call: availability, location, licenses, work authorization, and expected pay. Drop any question that would not change the decision, and generally avoid ones that reveal age or religion. Several states also ban asking for pay history.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask for two or three references, each with a phone number and how they know the applicant, and decide whether anyone calls them before or after an interview. The form closes with a statement the applicant signs and dates: I certify that my answers are true and complete.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Name each position in the prompt with the questions only it needs, and mark which are required. Keep each role's extras to a handful, since the shared sections carry most of the form. A long role-specific block usually belongs in a later screening step.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Decide which files each role requires. A resume can be optional for cashiers and required for office roles, while a cover letter stays optional everywhere. Limit uploads to PDF and DOCX files under 10 MB each.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Choose who hears about each application and how: the store manager in Slack, the recruiter by email. Then name the stages every applicant moves through before an offer. With a stage column added, the applicant table becomes the hiring pipeline your managers filter each morning.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Decide how paper applications get in. A QR code at the counter opens the same form on a phone. When someone hands in a paper copy instead, a manager types it in through the online form and it joins the table like any other.
fields.howto_step_7_des: Put the form on your careers page or on a custom domain, which Emergent includes and bills in credits. Then submit a test application for every role, and check that each shows its own questions and that the alert reaches the right person.

scope.evidence: H1 'Build a Job Application Form That Feeds Your Hiring Pipeline', meta title 'Job Application Form Template and Builder | Emergent' and hero 'Emergent builds the job application form and the applicant table behind it' cover the whole job, not screening or onboarding.

intent.evidence: Top 10 is printable applications and template galleries: FAQ 3 lists the six sections field by field, FAQ 4 and 7 cover the printable blank PDF and the one-page version, FAQ 5 answers the template search, and the meta promise 'Print a blank PDF for walk-ins' is delivered in FAQ 4 and step 6.

specificity.evidence: Hiring variant in the table ('Prompt for the application form and the hiring pipeline around it', 'Application limits'); hiring vocabulary: 'a block that repeats for each past employer', 'May we contact this employer?', 'BLS and ACLS cards'.

openers.evidence: Paragraphs open on full sentences: 'Emergent drafts the six standard sections', 'The first question is which store.', 'Employees apply with their employee ID', 'Decide which files each role requires.'

craft.evidence: QC Q2/Q5/Q7 clean; repeated custom-domain line and soft quantifiers recorded as notes.

voice.evidence: Concrete, unglamorous details: 'Haddad_RN.pdf', 'A forklift operator is asked for a certification date', 'months in their current role. This posting asks for at least 12'. Chip-prompt wording note only.

truth.evidence: EEOC one-year retention (29 CFR 1602.14), pay-history bans (DOL), age/religion questions (EEOC), OSHA forklift certification, AHA BLS/ACLS and AAMA CMA all match spec.domain_sources; Emergent claims map to prompt-build, no-caps, alerts, custom-domain, code-export, e-signature-capture.

distinct.evidence: Tabs (hourly stores, clinical credentials, confidential internal moves, salaried must-haves) are hiring-specific; siblings (new employee form, candidate screening form) are linked in FAQ 8 and 10, not used as headings.

faq.evidence: 10 on-topic questions from the related searches and secondaries, each answered in its first sentence; hub link in item 2; links to new employee form and candidate screening form help the reader.

images.evidence: Tab 1 'Weekends: yes, start Nov 3' and 'To Leo Park, store manager'; tab 2 'Ben Walsh, RN / Expires in 52 days, under 60'; tab 3 'Slack direct message, not a channel'; tab 4 '3 applicants' + '1 applicant missed a must-have' all match the copy; flags and holds go to Anglo names (Ben Walsh, Tom Baker), no row-29 pattern.

claims_to_source: A standard job application has six sections: applicant details, position, work history, education, references and a signed certification
The certification statement says the applicant's answers are true and complete
Employers may ask whether an applicant is legally authorized to work in the US
Nurse licenses are issued by a state board of nursing and carry a license number and an expiration date
Medical assistants are mostly unlicensed by states; the CMA is a certification awarded by the AAMA
BLS and ACLS are provider cards issued after American Heart Association courses
Internal transfer policies commonly set a minimum time in the current role, keep the initial application confidential and bring in the current manager at the finalist interview stage
Application questions that would reveal age or religion should generally be avoided
Employers may ask for expected pay; a number of states ban asking for pay history
Forklift operators are trained and certified by the employer under OSHA 1910.178(l)
Employers covered by EEOC rules keep all application forms, hired or not, for one year

chip_prompts: Build a job application form where applicants upload a resume and any license the role requires from their phone, with each file saved to their application.
Build a job application form for my stores that asks which location, a start date, and the shifts each applicant can work, weekends included.
Build a job application form that keeps every submission as a filled PDF in the same layout, ready to print for the personnel file.
Build a job application form that adds each applicant to a table with role, stage, and owner, and alerts the hiring manager in Slack.

chip_adds: Add resume uploads saved with each application.
Add a question for the shifts each applicant can work.
